newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Shares worth $3 billion in Abu Dhabi free zone will be offered for subscription in September.
- Dubai emirate in the UAE non-oil trade was worth $22.3 billion in 1996.
- Kind Fahd of Saudi Arabia to inaugurate 90-member Shura council on Monday.
- Jordanian banks to offer free shares worth $52 million to raise capital.
- Kuwait plans to build tourism projects on its southern coast.
